what: Matan's reviewed cross-section decisions for the CMS MC normalisation registry (v4 decisions, 15 Oct 2026). Input of record for build_registry.py; the older v2 sources stay untouched in this folder as history.
convention: cross_section_pb is sigma_eff = production sigma x branching ratio x any generator selection x any k-factor. k_factor and gen_filt_eff stay pinned to 1.0 in the registry; sum_of_weights stays null (measured at build time).
transcription_note: Values, constructions, citations and orders are transcribed from the decision list as given. Nothing here was re-derived or rounded. Where the stated construction does not reproduce the decided value exactly, the decided value is kept and the difference is recorded in `arithmetic_note`.
